'''Teleother Camelot''' is a [[member]]'s spell which requires a [[Magic]] level of 90 and teleports the target player, who has [[Accept Aid]] switched on, to [[Camelot]]. A window will pop for the person being teleported asking them if they wished to be teleported.

==Trivia==
* [[Solus Dellagar]] forcibly casts Teleother Camelot on the player during [[Wanted!]]. The player has no option to cancel it.
